review: You know how you had Clay Daly on as a guest? You think you could do that again, except without either Scott or Peter? And then maybe make it permanent?
Of all the podcasts in the world, this is one of them!
Sometimes Scott and Peter talk, and other times there's amazing, blissful silence.
This podcast is an outstanding example of why not every idea that pops into your head is a good one.
Just when I think these guys are finally growing on me, I realize that's just a terrible fungus.
Sometimes you need a really good podcast to listen to. Other times you just need background noise. This is background noise.
I was cutting them some slack because they are drinking beer, but then they started drinking coffee sometimes and I realized they just really are that stupid.
I listened to the WHOLE episode, not because of how great it was, but because I was working on my car, my hands were covered in grease, and I couldn't skip ahead to something else. You're welcome.
Your podcast is like the Apple Watch – it's saving lives!

You know that time you won 452 million dollars in the lottery and then lost it all gambling and drinking and paying hitmen for services rendered? Yeah, this podcast is exactly like that except without the part about winning the 452 million dollars.
